summary: Privileged scratch-pad access to production log slices for billing correction run
description:
Issue summary: Finance has identified ~120 customer invoices with tokenization mismatches traced to a malformed metadata enrichment job that ran on 2026-03-08. We need a scoped, privileged log slice to reproduce the join conditions and verify corrected invoice outputs.

Impact: Without a focused extract, Finance cannot validate refunds and billing adjustments; estimated $$ exposure is small but time-sensitive for month-end close.

Purpose & scope: Requesting read-only access to a tightly scoped set of production request/response logs and enrichment metadata for the job window 2026-03-08 02:00 UTC -> 2026-03-08 04:00 UTC, limited to request IDs provided below (approx 2400 entries). No full session dumps. This is a data-correction verification exercise, not an incident investigation.

Access requested: A temporary "scratch-pad" bucket (S3 path or ephemeral view) containing masked log slices with original request_id, enrichment_metadata (hashed PII fields), model_id, route, timestamps, and billing_key. Raw customer payloads must be redacted per the redaction pattern described in Controls proposed. Duration: 48 hours of access.

Justification: Finance requires deterministic reproduction of the join to validate corrected billing hashes and to produce a signed affidavit for accounting. Prior attempts with anonymized aggregates were insufficient.

Data minimization: Only the 2400 request_ids provided in attachments will be included. PII fields will be hashed with HMAC-SHA256 using a KMS key and then truncated; the original plaintext will not be exposed. Full KV-cache payloads, embeddings, and free-form customer content fields are excluded.

Requested reviewers/approvals: Security, Data Governance, and Finance lead sign-off required before provisioning.
request_details: Target storage: ephemeral S3 path in prod account with brokered access-control and automatic expiry
Fields requested: request_id, timestamp, route, model_id, enrichment_metadata (HMAC-hashed), billing_key, status_code
controls_proposed: Access via brokered IAM role with dual approval (Security + Finance)
Ephemeral S3 path with object-level encryption and auto-delete after TTL (48h)
KMS-wrapped HMAC hashing applied to PII before storage
Download disabled — analysis should be performed in a locked analysis notebook in prod-analytics cluster
Full audit trail recorded to central audit logs and retained for 90 days
